map.应力集中（本页代码口径）：最大应力 σ_max=K_t×名义应力（MPa）；联动: Stress concentration (per this page's code): maximum stress σ_max = K_t × nominal stress (MPa); linked values: amplification factor = σ_max ÷ nominal stress, back-calculated nominal stress = nominal stress ÷ K_t, stress increase = σ_max − nominal stress. Validation: both fields are required by the input guard and must be valid numbers, otherwise prompt and abort. Criteria: no fixed grading; σ_max is linearly related to K_t, and K_t is the local stress amplification relative to nominal stress.
